s1.description: The opportunity: most Stories orders stop at one item, and the usual fixes leak margin.

s2.description: The product: a till engine that suggests the profitable other half of the pair and learns from every answer.

s3.description: The evidence: what it earns, how it learns, and why the numbers can be trusted.

s4.description: The plan: an eight-week pilot, then every branch, then other cafés.
